lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap, a crowdsourced geographic database maintained by volunteers. The dataset contains approximately 589.7 thousand buildings in Tunisia with metadata on data age and recent updates. Geometries are provided in multiple standard formats (SHP, KML, GeoJSON, Geopackage) for interoperability.
